title: Best wing at a 1 N·m torque budget for each half-span, 300-700 mm, 0.5 mm sheet pivoting on the leading edge
author: sam
question: For a 0.5 mm sheet pivoting freely about a straight leading edge at 1 Hz, how does the best thrust under a 1 N·m peak-torque budget change with half-span from 300 to 700 mm, and what outline does each span want?
notes: One lineage per seed half-span, span fixed (a tip chord may still reach zero and shorten the wing), so the winners trace best thrust at 1 N·m against span. Seeds above the budget first walk down in torque, then climb thrust. Every trial, accepted or not, is kept, which fills the atlas around 1 N·m. Same model, motion and numerics as the parent free-span study, whose lambda searches settled at 440-480 mm.
